# pawmap

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The pawmap package contains utilities for interacting with data from the City of
Portland's [Portland Area Watershed Monitoring and Assessment Program](https://www.portland.gov/bes/protecting-rivers-streams/watershed-monitoring/portland-area-watershed-monitoring-and). Data packages in the form of a zip file containing
PAWMAP data will be available from the [pawmap-data](https://github.com/jasonelaw/pawmap-data)
repository. An example data package is included with the pawmap package. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of pawmap from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jasonelaw/pawmap")
```

## Examples

You can list files in a data package:

```{r files}
library(pawmap)
package_files()
```

Each data package contains an OGC GeoPackage file `layers.gpkg`. The included
layers can be listed:

```{r layers}
package_layers()
```

Files can be read from the data package:

```{r read}
locations <- read_package_csv("locations.csv")
locations

catchment <- read_package_gpkg("catchment")
catchment
```

Much more functionality remains to be added. Stay tuned.
